question: A man invested Rs.96,000 at the rate of 20% per annum, compounded half-yearly for 1 year. What would be 80% of the amount (in Rs.) which he will get on maturity?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹96,000

Rate (R) = 20% per annum ⇒ 10% per half-year

Time = 1 year = 2 half-years

**Formula used:**

Amount A = P(1 + (r)/(100))^t

Required = 80% of A

**Calculations:**

A = 96000 × (1 + 10/100)² = 96000 × (1.1)² = 96000 × 1.21 = ₹116160

80% of ₹116160 = 116160 × 0.8 = ₹92928

**∴ 80% of the amount on maturity = ₹92,928**
